Title.Addition: Offence of keeping vehicle which does not meet insurance requirements

Text.Addition: If a motor vehicle registered under the Vehicle Excise and Registration Act 1994 does not meet the insurance requirements, the person in whose name the vehicle is registered is guilty of an offence.
For the purposes of this Article a vehicle meets the insurance requirements if–
it is covered by a such a policy of insurance or such a security in respect of third party risks as complies with the requirements of this Part, and
either of the following conditions is satisfied.

The first condition is that the policy or security, or the certificate of insurance or security which relates to it, identifies the vehicle by its registration mark as a vehicle which is covered by the policy or security.
The second condition is that the vehicle is covered by the policy or security because–

the policy or security covers any vehicle, or any vehicle of a particular description, the owner of which is a person named in the policy or security or in the certificate of insurance or security which relates to it, and
the vehicle is owned by that person.
For the purposes of this Article a vehicle is covered by a policy of insurance or security if the policy of insurance or security is in force in relation to the use of the vehicle.

Para.Text: Arts. 91A-91D inserted (prosp.) by Road Traffic (Northern Ireland) Order 2007 (S.I. 2007/916 (N.I. 10)), arts. 1(3)(4), 25(1)
